versions.content: If the start of new physical request (SF or FF) is received while reception of a physical request is ongoing , the LIN Interface shall stop the current LIN TP message reception (see also SWS_LinIf_00651) . If the received NAD matches the configured NAD or broadcast NAD, the new request shall be accepted.
